title: Installation Guide
wikitext:
{{TOC|align=right}}
To install Stardew Valley Expanded, please follow closely. It is '''strongly recommended to start a new save for first time play.'''

# Download the mod and all of its requirements.
# Using a program capable of unzipping zipped-up files, unzip your downloaded mods.
# For a first-time installation, see '''First Time Install'''
# For existing saves: see '''Updating/Reinstalling'''

==Requirements (aka "Dependencies")==
{|class="wikitable"
! Mod Name
|-
|[https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915 Content Patcher]
|-
|[https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231 Farm Type Manager (FTM)]
|}

== First Time Install ==
For a first time installation:
# Make sure you have the most up-to-date version of [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400 SMAPI].
# Download Stardew Valley Expanded and '''all''' of the required mods listed above. 
# Locate your "Mods" folder (click [[Stardew:Modding:Player_Guide#Getting_Started#Getting_started|here]] for instructions on how to find your mods folder).
# Unzip each of the mod files and place into your "Mods" folder.

===Optional Files===
When adding SVE to a new save, you have the option to also utilize different [[Farm Maps|Farm Map]] layouts. If you decide to use one of these new maps, pick only one to download.
{{Note|Installing all of them will result in problems.}}
{|class="wikitable"
! Farm Map Name
|-
|[[Frontier Farm]]
|-
|[[Grandpa's Farm]]
|-
|[[Immersive Farm 2 Remastered]]
|}

You will also have the option to install [[Grampleton Fields]], which is a large farmable area located east of [[Shearwater Bridge]].

== Updating/Reinstalling ==
When updating/reinstalling Stardew Valley Expanded, it is ''critical'' to '''delete any existing versions''' before placing the new files in your Mods folder. Deleting older versions will not harm your save files. Follow the same steps as for a first-time installation. {{Note|Overwriting files will cause problems.}} 


If adding Stardew Valley Expanded for the first time to an existing save (not recommended for storyline reasons), you will need to take additional steps.
# Download and install [https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases Reset Terrain Features]. See the mod page for instructions on how to open the menu. You will need to reset all trees, bushes, and terrain features. If you don't, terrain features will be out of sync and won't make sense.
# Download and install [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900 Noclip Mode], which could be needed to access areas made inaccessible by the changes.
# Optionally, download and install [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4 CJB Cheats] and [https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93 CJB Item Spawner], which can be used to pause time and manually place grass starters, respectively.
